lore: While the ferry is out every island keeps editing the same saves, each by its own tower clock, and no two towers agree. When the ferry lands the edits meet. Trust the towers and a later edit on a slow clock vanishes; count ticks and the order is honest but a rival edit still vanishes. Only the tide clocks, one hand per island, know when two edits never saw each other.

lines.start: Five towers, five wrong clocks. Choose which hand decides when the ferry lands.
lines.ferry: The ferry is in. Let the edits meet.
lines.conflict: These two never saw each other. Take both to the Merge Keeper.
lines.win: Not one edit lost. Every rival went to the Merge Keeper.
lines.fail: An edit vanished in the merge and nobody noticed. Wind the tide clocks.
